This looks great. I'd also like to share that it'll soon be possible for CLs to "extend blobs" ("compute cells" is more clear IMO btw 🙂). We've added the function to the specs (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4128) and implemented it in ckzg (https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/pull/534). Hope to have a new ckzg release with this sometime next week. hmm i tried resyncing lighthouse-geth-5,prysm-geth-5 and teku-geth-5 and they all fail with the EL crashing on the electra slot. Does someone have ideas? I know lodestar was also struggling with this when genesis syncing <@931591385545584640> . It could also be a config issue, but if a node produced the block then the same one should be able to sync it too ah this was with checkpoint sync, im going to try genesis sync first what was the error that they got from the EL we found a couple different errors the el had the invalid block (Error: invalid merkle root) on block 32 Right after electra, Prysm says that: did you find it while syncing or otherwise? while syncing can we use default el image? got `newPayloadV4 must only be called for prague payloads` but the sync is progressing So we were able to get around those two on the PeerDAS image. We are getting rejected with "building on previous invalid block". I didn't see the invalid root Error but it's possible that error got buried and all we saw was our error when we submitted the next block. Will dig in the logs again when I'm at the keys I never tried to sync prysm from a checkpoint sync. I did try to sync it (with success) from genesis (with both an empty and a pre-existing database). On both a finalizing AND an unfinalizing network. feels like this could be a EL bug then? if there's nothing off in the CL

A more detailed write-up on this, nothing new from what we discussed earlier, but just hoping to give others a bit of context and get some feedback from the EL teams: 
https://hackmd.io/@jimmygchen/HkUpFliYJx

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Nice! This looks great. I'd also like to share that it'll soon be possible for CLs to "extend blobs" ("compute cells" is more clear IMO btw 🙂). We've added the function to the specs (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4128) and implemented it in ckzg (https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/pull/534). Hope to have a new ckzg release with this sometime next week.
